assets.provenance: Actual capture of PanCode 0.9.1, packed from branch site/v080-sprint at 0d1f36358 ahead of the release and installed with npm install -g, on 2026-11-12. Recorded by site/capture/run.mjs (scenario still-tui-boot) in a fresh bubblewrap profile (home /home/researcher, host lab) with its own network namespace, interface.demo on and interface.outputDetail set to detailed. Fixed 120x44 terminal recorded as asciinema v2 and rendered by the site's player in IBM Plex Mono at 2x. Qwen 3.8 27B through a LiteLLM gateway, reached through the capture harness's alias proxy, so the model id shows no host name. Fresh launch in ~/projects/calibration-lab, no prompt sent. Welcome panel, composer and footer (rows 3-24).

Rendered by agg from site/assets/casts/anim-fix-a-test.cast, recorded from PanCode 0.9.1 by site/capture/animation.mjs.
assets.role: Fix a test
assets.altTextSeed: Fullscreen terminal recording of PanCode on gpt-6-luna: the question why the absolute-zero test fails is typed into the composer and sent with a request to fix it and run the test check; Panos explores the project with 5 searches and 2 files, runs the test check and sees 6 pass and 1 fail, edits one line of temperature.mjs, runs the test check again with exit 0, and explains that kelvinToCelsius rejected 0 K because its check used <= 0 and that all 7 tests passed, in 11s.

assets.provenance: Rendered by agg from site/assets/casts/anim-model-switch.cast, recorded from PanCode 0.9.1 by site/capture/animation.mjs.
assets.role: Switch models
assets.altTextSeed: Fullscreen terminal recording of the /model picker in PanCode on GitHub Copilot: the session starts on gpt-6-luna, the picker lists 26 models on the copilot target, and claude-sonnet-5.5 and gemini-4-argon are chosen in turn by typing part of the name, each changing the status bar's model and context size, before the session returns to gpt-6-luna.

assets.provenance: Rendered by agg from site/assets/casts/anim-api-fix.cast, recorded from PanCode 0.9.1 by site/capture/animation.mjs.
assets.role: Fix a test
assets.altTextSeed: Fullscreen terminal recording of PanCode on gpt-6-luna in the bookshelf-api project: the request that the last-page test fails, to find the cause, fix it and run the test check, is typed into the composer; Panos explores with 6 searches and 3 files, edits one line of src/paginate.ts, runs the test check with exit 0, and explains that paginate used Math.floor and reported 2 pages for 25 books at 10 per page, so it changed it to Math.ceil and the full test check passes, 7/7, in 11s.
